The image presents two grouped bar graphs, one for Deutschland and one for the EU, illustrating the percentage values for Aluminium, Kupfer, and Nickel across three years: 2021, 2022, and 2023. The horizontal axis lists the materials, while the vertical axis represents the percentage, ranging from 0% to 30% in increments of 5%. 

In the Deutschland graph, the blue, purple, and grey bars represent the years 2021, 2022, and 2023, respectively. The values for 2021 are 3.6% for Aluminium, 8.3% for Kupfer, and 25.1% for Nickel. For 2022, the values are 2.7% for Aluminium, 11.3% for Kupfer, and 24.7% for Nickel. In 2023, the values are 1.0% for Aluminium, 2.2% for Kupfer, and 11.4% for Nickel. 

The EU graph displays similar trends, with the blue, purple, and grey bars representing the same years. The values for 2021 are 3.2% for Aluminium, 4.4% for Kupfer, and 24.3% for Nickel. For 2022, the values are 2.8% for Aluminium, 5.1% for Kupfer, and 23.3% for Nickel. In 2023, the values are 1.7% for Aluminium, 1.3% for Kupfer, and 14.6% for Nickel. 

The bars in both graphs are arranged in a grouped format, allowing for a visual comparison of the percentage values for each material across the three years.
